question: Glucocorticoids (steroids) can cause delayed wound healing primarily by affecting which of the following?
explanation: Glucocorticoids are potent anti-inflammatory agents that suppress the entire inflammatory response. They directly inhibit the proliferation and function of fibroblasts, which in turn leads to impaired collagen synthesis (Option B) and a weaker, delayed scar. Since the inhibition of the cell itself (fibroblast) is the primary action, A is the best answer.
